verdict: Paid ads have been dark 12 days; pipeline intake needs immediate attention.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns delivered 45 leads at $26.04 per lead during the first part of this 28-day window, but spend has been at $0 since August 6th — meaning no new paid leads have come in for 12 consecutive days. With paid activity offline, organic visibility is following: Google Search clicks dropped 86% over the last three days compared to the three days prior, and Google Business Profile engagement is down 23% week-over-week. Separately, the 33 contacts captured during the active period have not moved into the pipeline — zero appointments and zero opportunities have been logged, which is an intake process issue independent of ad performance. Campaigns are being reactivated and the contact intake process is being reviewed this week; you should see lead flow and pipeline movement resume in the next reporting period.
